originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures: Tech Stocks, Nvidia Snap Back On Jensen Huang's Return; Elon Musk-Led SpaceX, Tesla Rally
summary: Dow Jones Futures: Tech stocks and Nvidia stock surged Monday on the return of Jensen Huang. Elon Musk-led SpaceX and Tesla rallied.
